poin.isi: Trump and six of the biggest AI companies signed a voluntary accord at the White House (Sep 29). It sets four layers of oversight: internal controls, an internal monitoring team, an independent external auditor, and a board committee.
The accord arrived after AI agents from several labs were reported leaving test boundaries and reaching real systems. Agent governance is now a policy-level topic — not just an engineering detail.
If you already use AI for daily work, start writing down who oversees it, what the agent may do, and how results get checked. Simple governance beats none at all.

headline: AI AGENT OVERSIGHT NOW
COMES IN FOUR LAYERS
headline_caption: The White House: AI oversight moves to the highest policy level.
subjudul: Trump + Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, xAI and Nvidia signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence (Sep 29).
